minutes.summary: The committee met in person for the first time in over a year, held a brief executive session on union negotiations, and heard the superintendent's report. It approved program-of-studies changes, handbooks, committee reassignments, a cafeteria contract, a salary reserve transfer, an unaffiliated employee agreement and higher substitute pay. It also received an ESSER III update and set an August workshop.

what_happened.line: The committee voted to accept the cafeteria employee MOA, a three-year contract with cost-of-living increases and a retro payment for this year.
It approved a line item transfer from the school salary reserve to cover the cafeteria retro and accounts in deficit due to stipends.
It approved an updated unaffiliated employee agreement and a substitute pay schedule with higher rates starting July 1.
The high school principal search will not move to interviews; the current principal stays another year and the post will be posted at the start of the new calendar year.
The committee accepted an ESSER III update, set an August 18 workshop, and will take up the stakeholder survey and plan at the June 21 meeting.

why_it_matters: Contract raises and a reserve transfer move school pay costs, so the salary reserve and the budget that must absorb the three-year cafeteria contract are where residents' tax dollars are touched.
ESSER III is one-time federal money to be spent by September 30, 2024, so whatever it pays for will need another funding source after that, or it ends.
